Rescued b756b4bb into the main repo. Evidence: docs/refactor/evidence/masc-rescue-20260921/README.md (commit 924e8dd6) and cold-review.json (repairs in commit 64f5d86c). Both are local main and unpushed.

1. Ref: refs/heads/rescue/audit-masc-role-corpus -> b756b4bb1aca375a14fd26d024e2b3a578ba8688.
2. `git for-each-ref --contains b756b4bb` in main lists exactly that ref.
3. Tree 69b7c7c3b5f1729cdb6806fe974683e4200bfbe1 is the same in main and in the clone. All 12 new objects are present in main.
4. Clone sweep: 8 local refs, 180 remote-tracking refs, 15 reflog commits, 0 stashes, 157 own-store objects and FETCH_HEAD/ORIG_HEAD are all reachable from main refs. The clone uses main as an object alternate, so its 227 dangling commits are main's own objects. The one other clone tip outside main's refs, 91333a46 (an amended-away earlier version of bbceb824), is kept as refs/heads/rescue/world-order-input-pre-amend. Listed for the owner.
5. The progress note records the ref, the tree id and the reachability check.

Gate: a fresh-context read-only cold review reproduced every count and found criteria 1-5 met. Its five overclaims and two misses are repaired in 64f5d86c.

Main-side side finding: 258 main commits are unreachable from refs; 244 are protected only by reflogs (default 30-day expiry) and 14 by nothing (redundant by patch-id). Two with no same-subject commit on main are pinned under refs/salvage/unreferenced-20260921/ (3 commits) and listed for the owner. d736dc56 is grakern's and is held in ../grakern.

Not established: no push, so no off-machine copy exists. No review, merge or rerun of the MASC audit. Nothing was deleted. The dependent cleanup bead bd-01M2TA2TWN5QS8PT01VW7JX234 still needs the owner's OK.
